name: When should I be concerned about a drywall crack?

mainEntity.name: When should I be concerned about a drywall crack?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should be concerned about drywall cracks if they are wider than a quarter-inch, run diagonally, appear in multiple rooms, or are accompanied by other signs like sticking doors/windows or sagging floors. These could indicate structural issues requiring professional assessment, whereas small hairline cracks are usually less serious and can be repaired cosmetically.
acceptedAnswer.description: Be concerned about cracks wider than a quarter-inch, diagonal cracks, or those accompanied by structural issues like sticking doors or sagging floors.
